title: Cybernetic Sorceress in Battle
description: A female character with teal hair and glowing cybernetic armor floats dynamically in mid-air, holding a large futuristic staff that emits turquoise energy. She is surrounded by floating crystalline shards, holographic elements, and a smaller winged figure in the background against a chaotic, debris-filled cosmic battlefield.
